scope: One public A6000 scene, Lightroom profile-off vs Adobe D100/V0 exports, both with mandatory builtin CA. Spatial agreement observation, not manufacturer frame selection, optical truth, TCA/vignette acceptance or product support.

builtinCA.evidence: Lightroom builtin profile information popup observed during acquisition

registration.pixelInput: 8-bit reduced luminance from original 16-bit sRGB PNG; spatial comparison only
registration.refinement: Independent cubic local affine patch alignment, normalized intensities, minimum refined NCC .985

limitations: Adobe uses its own optical calibration, not necessarily the Sony embedded table.
A best fitting frame is not a manufacturer contract and must not enable product rendering.
One natural scene and local patch translation have finite accuracy; no all-camera coverage claim.
Vignetting was set to zero; ordinary AutoLateralCA=0 does not disable builtin CA.
